evidence: The XPS depth profile spectra confirm the growth of SnO x film. The spectra shown in Supplementary Figure S5 confirm the growth of SnO x film. While the thickness cannot be quantified using the attenuation of underlying Si signal of the depth profile XPS data since there is no detectable Si2P contribution prior to sputtering, it is clear that these films are thicker than the films deposited at 200 °C. Indeed, it takes 300 s of sputter time to remove the SnOx films grown at 300 °C instead of on 90 s for films grown at 200 °C. In both cases, the XPS data confirm that the films are carbon free (i.e. C 1s removed by 5 s sputtering).
